input: Build a simple wooden toolbox from scratch

gold.taskTitle: Build a Simple Wooden Toolbox from Scratch
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to design and construct a basic wooden toolbox from raw materials with no pre-made kit.

questions.title: What tools and power equipment do you currently own?
questions.description: Understanding available tools helps determine which cuts, joints, and assembly methods are feasible.

questions.title: What type of wood are you planning to use?
questions.description: The species and form of wood (pine, plywood, hardwood, reclaimed) affects cost, workability, and finish.

questions.title: What size toolbox do you need it to be?
questions.description: Dimensions determine how much material to buy and how the box will be structured internally.

questions.title: Will the toolbox have a lid, handle, or compartments?
questions.description: Specific features like a hinged lid, rope handle, or internal dividers change the build complexity significantly.

questions.title: What types of tools will it store and carry?
questions.description: The contents determine weight load requirements, internal layout, and how sturdy the construction needs to be.

questions.title: Do you have a set budget for materials?
questions.description: A budget helps narrow down wood type, hardware choices, and whether any components need to be sourced cheaply.

questions.title: What is your experience level with woodworking?
questions.description: Skill level shapes which joinery methods, finishing steps, and tool techniques are appropriate to recommend.
